description: Recommend the top surf beaches in SurfBooking zones right now. Pass `level` for a LEVEL-AWARE ranking — the best spots for a beginner / advanced surfer at this moment, weighted by how well each spot's live wave fits that level. Without `level`, ranks by the live SurfBooking Index (conditions + activity). Best for 'where's good to surf now?' / 'best beach for a beginner today?'. Optionally filter by zone. It ranks beaches for right now, not the best day ahead, and returns no lessons. This returns BEACHES, not lessons.

level.description: Optional — surfer level. When given, ranks spots by how well each one's live conditions fit that level (a 0.6m beach is great for a beginner, poor for advanced).

limit.description: Optional — how many to return (default 6, max 12).

zone.description: Optional — zone/region name to filter by, e.g. 'Ericeira'.

name: recommend_spots
title: Recommended spots
